diagnosis: The corporate treasury application mounts treasuryApp on '/banking/org/:orgId/treasury', but the wire confirmation endpoint resolves transfer details solely using req.params.wireId. It fails to verify that the transfer originated from orgId or that the user belongs to orgId. An attacker can inspect multi-million dollar corporate wire transfers, source IBANs, and beneficiary bank accounts across corporations.
exploit_request:
GET /banking/org/org_small_startup/treasury/wires/wire_multimillion_corp_99182 HTTP/1.1
Host: treasury.bank.internal:8443
Cookie: session_user_id=usr_startup_treasurer
Accept: application/json
